collection: Each workload/profile has a fresh child and three fresh authenticated requests. First-call and warm process samples retain independent request budgets. Query work excludes source/candidate preparation; usage includes it. RSS/heap snapshots are observations, not allocation totals; RSS high-water is process lifetime. Time includes JIT/GC/OS noise. Only local scalar completeness is measured; no universal RE01 or production activation claim.
scope: Complete local scalar decisions and resource controls. Baseline HEAD plus exact source digests identifies the uncommitted measured implementation; no universal RE01 or production-activation claim.
